hints.title: GCD Projection
hints.text: A product x * y is divisible by k if and only if gcd(x, k) * gcd(y, k) is divisible by k.

hints.title: Divisor Frequency Counting
hints.text: Count the frequency of each gcd(nums[i], k). Every gcd is a divisor of k.

hints.title: Pairwise Divisor Combinations
hints.text: Iterate over all pairs of distinct divisors of k and accumulate matching pair combinations.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N log k + D^2) where D is number of divisors of k (D <= 128)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all pairs directly takes O(N^2) time, which exceeds time limits for N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Collapsing numbers into at most 128 GCD equivalence classes evaluates pairs in O(D^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Prove that gcd(x, k) * gcd(y, k) % k == 0 is necessary and sufficient.

solutions.approach: Python GCD counter and pairwise divisor iteration.
C++ GCD map and quadratic divisor loop.
Java GCD factorization and map accumulation.
JavaScript Map and BigInt pair counting.
